thread:
Maeve: Quick pulse — CS sprint idea: instead of 90m workshops, run 30m 'microclinics' for onboarding customers with a focused renewal-risk check. Thoughts?
Luis: Love the idea. Lower friction for customers. Suggest weekly Tue/Thu 11:30-12:00 PT to start.
Aisha: Can we reserve 4 slots per week and prioritize accounts flagged as at-risk this quarter (top 5)?
Jon: I can cover the Wed EMEA-friendly slot (Wed 16:00 CET). Will need a short agenda template to keep things tight.
Kriti: Agenda proposal: 10m quick recap & goals, 15m live walkthrough (config + infra checks), 5m feedback + next steps.
Maeve: That works. Also want to capture two quick signals during the session: immediate blockers and renewal intent. I'll draft a 60s survey.
Luis: Could calendar invites include a 'renewal-risk' tag and a CS owner field? Then we can filter events for follow-ups.
calendar-bot: created event 'Microclinic: Onboard + Renewal Check' Tue/Thu 11:30 PT / Wed 16:00 CET, 30m recurring weekly.
Aisha: I'll build a one-page cheat sheet and a 6-step checklist for session leads (login checks, model pin, traffic test, eval sample, cost guardrails, follow-up).
Jon: Request: rotate a product SME into one session/month for tricky model questions. @Kriti could you take the monthly slot?
Kriti: Yep I can join first Wed of month for the monthly deep-dive.
Maeve: For feedback capture, short survey fields: 1) Blocked? (yes/no) 2) Confidence to ship to prod (0-100%) 3) One-line ask for CS handoff. Keep it required.
Luis: Add two more metadata fields on the invite: 'follow-up owner' and 'priority (P0/P1/P2)' so SRE/Eng can triage.
Maeve: Good call. I'll update the invite template and attach the survey link.
Luis: Who's running a pilot? We should test with a current onboard and one renewal-risk account.
Aisha: I'll run the pilot Tue 11:30 PT with NovaHealth (onboarding), and include Renewal check for the account.
Jon: I'll shadow the pilot, capture notes and metrics (time to resolution, follow-up rate, customer NPS).
Kriti: I'll add the agenda & template to the internal docs and link it in the calendar invite.
Maeve: Action items: Aisha (pilot), Jon (metrics/notes), Kriti (docs), Luis (calendar ops). We'll post a 5-min retro in #cs-feedback after each session.
Aisha: noted :thumbsup:
ops-bot: labeled account NovaHealth with 'renewal-risk' and notified AE.
calendar-bot: Created calendar event instance for 2026-03-31T18:30:00Z (pilot) and invited NovaHealth.
Maeve: Great. Closing this thread — I'll push the invite template and survey, and we'll iterate after the pilot.
